description.value: Apple Tree Inn is a family-owned, ground-level motel in Radium Hot Springs at the edge of the Rocky Mountains, offering 1- and 2-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchenettes. It is pet-friendly and positioned within walking distance of the town's restaurants and shops, with the Radium Hot Pools just two minutes away. Guest reviews highlight attentive ownership and clean, affordable rooms that suit both solo travellers and family groups.
